descriptionPlain:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


Job Title
Talent Acquisition Intern – Non-Tech Recruitment

About the Role
As a Talent Acquisition Intern (Non-Tech), you will play an active role in driving talent identification and engagement across Paytm’s business, sales, operations, and corporate functions. Working closely with recruiters and business stakeholders, you will help source, screen, and coordinate candidates to fuel Paytm’s fast-paced growth.
This role is ideal for a proactive, energetic individual with strong communication skills, high learning agility, and an interest in modern, technology-enabled hiring practices. You will gain hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment operations and candidate management in a high-volume fintech ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
Candidate Sourcing: Leverage job boards, social channels, campus databases, and internal platforms to source qualified candidates for business, sales, and enabling function roles.
Screening & Assessment: Conduct initial resume screening and phone evaluations to assess candidate suitability, communication skills, and role alignment.
Interview Coordination: Manage end-to-end scheduling of interviews, candidate communications, and logistics to ensure a seamless candidate experience.
Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate candidate data and application stages across the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and internal recruitment trackers.
Market Research: Perform basic market mapping and talent research to support recruiter search strategies for specialized non-tech profiles.
Process Automation & AI Adoption: Utilize modern sourcing tools, AI prompts, and automated communication platforms to speed up top-of-funnel hiring workflows.

Required Qualifications
Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related fields preferred).
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to engage candidates professionally.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail when managing multiple calendars and candidate pipelines.
High learning agility, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides).
Preferred Qualifications
Prior internship experience in HR, recruitment, candidate sourcing, or talent coordination.
Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and professional networking platforms like LinkedIn.
Interest in fintech, internet platforms, or high-growth technology environments.

AI Expectations
Sourcing & Search: Practical use of modern search methodologies and basic AI tools/prompts to quickly discover candidate profiles and boolean search strings.
Communication: Utilizing AI tools for drafting personalized candidate outreach messages, interview invitations, and follow-ups.
Productivity: Leveraging AI-driven tools and automation to summarize profiles, reduce administrative turnaround time, and improve daily recruitment throughput.

Ideal Candidate
Demonstrates Ownership & Bias for Action by taking initiative on daily sourcing and coordination tasks.
Exhibits Learning Agility with an eagerness to absorb recruiting best practices and stay open to new tools and ideas.
Displays Speed of Execution and adaptability in managing tight hiring schedules and candidate communication.
Strong focus on Candidate Experience and professional ethics.

Positions (MBA / Graduate) Location: Noida 

Mode: Work from Office (5 days a week) 

Duration: 3 Months

descriptionPlain:
Location: Noida 
Duration: 3 months 
Working days: 5 days work from office

About Paytm Group: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the role: A Talent Acquisition (TA) Intern will support the recruitment team in sourcing and screening candidates for technology roles. The role will involve working on real-time tech hiring requirements, coordinating interviews, candidate communication, maintaining recruitment trackers, and supporting hiring drives.

Key Responsibilities:

* Source and screen candidates for roles through LinkedIn, Naukri and other platforms.
* Identify relevant profiles based on technical requirements and job descriptions.
* Conduct initial candidate communication and HR screening calls.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates, recruiters and hiring managers.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases and hiring reports.
* Support job postings, offer documentation and candidate follow-ups.
* Work closely with recruiters and stakeholders to ensure smooth hiring.
* Assist with employer branding and other TA initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of Talent Acquisition and recruitment processes.
* Good sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Ability to understand basic technical job requirements.
* Good coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn, Naukri and other sourcing platforms will be an advantage.
* Proactive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Gain
Hands-on exposure to Talent Acquisition and recruitment operations.
Experience working on real-time technology hiring requirements.
Exposure to sourcing, screening, HR calls and interview coordination.
Experience handling hiring drives and recruitment reporting.
Opportunity to interact with candidates, recruiters and business stakeholders.
Practical understanding of the end-to-end recruitment process.

descriptionPlain:
Talent Acquisition Intern - Noida
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
HR – Recruitment /
Intern /
On-site

Location: Noida
Duration: 6 months
Working days: 5 days work from office

About Paytm Group: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the role: A Talent Acquisition (TA) Intern will support the recruitment team in sourcing and screening candidates for technology roles. The role will involve working on real-time tech hiring requirements, coordinating interviews, candidate communication, maintaining recruitment trackers, and supporting hiring drives.

Key Responsibilities:

* Source and screen candidates for Tech roles through LinkedIn, Naukri and other platforms.
* Identify relevant profiles based on technical requirements and job descriptions.
* Conduct initial candidate communication and HR screening calls.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates, recruiters and hiring managers.
* Support tech hiring drives, including weekend drives, as required.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases and hiring reports.
* Support job postings, offer documentation and candidate follow-ups.
* Work closely with recruiters and stakeholders to ensure smooth hiring.
* Assist with employer branding and other TA initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of Talent Acquisition and recruitment processes.
* Good sourcing and candidate screening skills.
* Ability to understand basic technical job requirements.
* Good coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn, Naukri and other sourcing platforms will be an advantage.
* Proactive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Gain
Hands-on exposure to Tech Talent Acquisition and recruitment operations.
Experience working on real-time technology hiring requirements.
Exposure to sourcing, screening, HR calls and interview coordination.
Experience handling tech hiring drives and recruitment reporting.
Opportunity to interact with candidates, recruiters and business stakeholders.
Practical understanding of the end-to-end recruitment process.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
